system.description:
At 9th level, you have further mastered the art of transmuting enchantments into garments. The rarity for Wondrous Items that you may transmute an enchantment from using your @UUID[Compendium.out-of-the-wilds.features.Item.SZHY7kD8nYsVYB83]{Concealed Alterations} feature increases to Rare. Creatures attempting to detect one of your Concealed Alterations via spells such as @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.kaye34nheyrit487]{Detect Magic} must now make a spellcasting ability check versus your spell save DC. On a failure, they fail to detect the enchantment.

Additionally, you know that in your line of work, sometimes the best offense is a good escape plan. As a reaction to being hit with an attack, you may grab the hem of a cape and twirl or deploy a trinket akin to a smoke bomb, temporarily disorienting your foes. You may automatically teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within 30 feet without provoking attacks of opportunity. Once you have used this ability, you cannot do so again until you complete a short or a long rest.
